description: Two GC.class_histogram snapshots spaced by intervalSeconds; returns classes whose instance count grew most. Use first in memory-leak workflow; then profile_memory and heap_dump (MAT path-to-GC-roots). Each snapshot walks the heap and may pause the app.

all.description: Include unreachable objects (-all). Triggers full GC and may pause the app.

intervalSeconds.description: Seconds between baseline and snapshot histograms. Default: 5.

minInstanceDelta.description: Ignore classes with instance growth below this threshold.

name: heap_live_histogram_diff
